status: DRAFT — not reviewed. Written 2026-09-26 by Claude for the group to check.
purpose: Path B names an office when no passage answers the question. Matching questions against the printed function statements failed (DATA_REPORT.md §6c), so this draft tries a keyword rule per department. The department list is closed (pp. 22-27). The keywords are NOT printed anywhere: they are our guesses at the words a student would use, each list tied to the printed function it expands.
rule: Tokenize the question and every keyword with shared/tokenizer.py (stemmed). A keyword hits when all its tokens appear in the question consecutively. A department scores the total token length of its hits, so 'air conditioner' outweighs 'fee'. Suggest the top 2-3 departments with a score above 0.

fallback.note: UNDECIDED. What Path B shows when no keyword hits. Options: name no office and point to the general information desk, or default to Student Affairs and Services.

known_weaknesses: Written by the same person who wrote the test questions, so the test in DATA_REPORT.md §6d is not independent. The group should write 10 fresh referral questions WITHOUT looking at this file and test those.
English only. Filipino or Taglish words (sira, bayad, CR as 'comfort room') are not covered except 'cr'.
Some words are shared across departments on purpose (e.g. 'lab' for Laboratory Services only; computer laboratories may belong to MIS). Needs the group's local knowledge.
'admission' is under the Registrar because of the group's 2026-09-26 decision, even though p. 27 prints an Admissions Department.

Stemming merges words across departments. 'account' (MIS) and 'accounting' (Finance) both stem to 'account', so an early draft suggested Finance for a portal-login question. Fixed by using 'portal account' / 'email account' and dropping 'accounting' (which also names the BS Accountancy program). Check every new keyword for the same trap.
